tools.name: market_access_check
tools.description: Free, unlimited EU/UK/US/AU product assessments with human review for a signed next-step pack. Send a plain-language `message` in English or Chinese; the first response already contains preliminary requirements. Follow `next_action`: execute it exactly as returned and answer questions by `key`. The

tools.name: preflight_product
tools.description: Check structured product facts, destination markets and evidence held. Returns requirements, an evidence checklist and gaps in one response. For plain-language input use market_access_check. Automated findings are provisional; a signed pack requires human review.

tools.name: watch_product_regulatory_changes
tools.description: Start free email alerts for a checked product when the seller explicitly requests them. Requires a real email, consent_to_alerts=true and a saved product/market profile. Covers matching human-reviewed ComplianceCN updates, not every regulatory change. There is no payment and no checkout step.

tools.name: compare_market_requirements
tools.description: Compare requirements for a product across 2-4 of EU, UK, US and Australia. Answers immediately: no case, no account, no follow-up. Send category, markets and known facts. Missing facts produce optional refinements; do not ask or rerun automatically.

tools.name: check_amazon_compliance_request
tools.description: Use when Amazon or another marketplace requests compliance files or suspends a listing pending documents. Returns the product/market evidence checklist, evidence held and gaps immediately; no case or follow-up required.

tools.name: check_battery_transport_documents
tools.description: Use when a forwarder or carrier queries or refuses a battery shipment. Returns applicable UN 38.3 test-summary requirements, shipping marks and transport evidence gaps for the cell/pack. Answers immediately from declared facts; does not inspect documents.

tools.name: check_label_and_packaging
tools.description: Use when checking labels, artwork or packaging. Returns destination-market marks, warning language, responsible-entity details and evidence gaps from declared product facts. Answers immediately; does not inspect artwork.

tools.name: check_us_import_certification
tools.description: Use when a US importer or broker requests CPC/GCC certification, FCC SDoC or entry-filing data. Returns applicable certificate requirements, supporting evidence and responsible-party details immediately; does not issue certificates.

tools.name: check_eu_declaration_basis
tools.description: Use when a buyer, customs or distributor requests an EU Declaration of Conformity. Returns applicable legislation, standards, evidence gaps and fields needing confirmation immediately. Does not issue or sign a declaration.

tools.name: explain_claim
tools.description: Retrieve the primary sources, verification date and evidence gaps for a claim_id from an earlier result. Copy the exact ID; not a general question-answering tool.

tools.name: describe_coverage
tools.description: Get a short scope and human-review service summary. Set detail=full for the coverage matrix, input definitions and methodology; optional, not a prerequisite. Start product cases at Stage 1 with market_access_check.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_label_and_packaging" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=official_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: market_access_check, preflight_product, check_us_import_certification, check_eu_declaration_basis, describe_coverage · Private data: check_amazon_compliance_request, check_battery_transport_documents · Public sink: market_access_check, watch_product_regulatory_changes, compare_market_requirements · Destructive: market_access_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: market_access_check, preflight_product, check_us_import_certification, check_eu_declaration_basis, describe_coverage · Private data: check_amazon_compliance_request, check_battery_transport_documents · Public sink: market_access_check, watch_product_regulatory_changes, compare_market_requirements · Destructive: market_access_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
